school: 三国吴国开国皇帝，刘备、孙权、曹操并称'三分天下'，东吴开创者，在位46年，奠定东吴基业
historical_significance: 孙权（183-252），字仲谋，吴郡濡阳人；孙策早亡，他继位后北伐中原，东吴疆域达峰，与曹操、刘备分庭抗礼；他能用吴国之力对抗中原诸强，既保全了东吴生存又推动了三国格局的形成；其政令以文武兼济，军事上以吴人水陆并用见长，外交上以结盟孙刘对抗曹魏，其 reign 标志着东吴从割据到正统的转型
historical_significance_en: Sun Quan (183-252), courtesy Zhongmou, from Wu County in Wu Commandery; after the early death of Sun Ce, he succeeded and northern expeditions to Central China, the Eastern Wu territory reached its peak, standing side by side with Cao Liu in a tripartite division of the realm; he was able to use the strength of Eastern Wu to resist the warlords of Central China, preserving Eastern Wu's survival while pushing forward the Three Kingdoms tripartite confrontation; his rule with both civil and military administration, with water and land forces employed by Wu people, and diplomatic alliances with Sun-Liu against Cao Wei, marked Eastern Wu's transition from regional warlord to legitimate regime
unique_thinking: 孙权的独特处在于：他把'生存'转化为'正统'——不像北方诸侯以霸权自居，他把东吴建设成为可以与北方正统抗衡的合法政权；他把'守成'转化为'突破'——在继承父业的基础上，既维护了东吴既有利益又创新了军政体制；他把'妥协'转化为'战略耐力'——在曹魏强压下不轻易开战，以持久战战略博取最终主动；他最深的原则是把国家的兴衰置于个人恩怨之上：舍弃亲兄以承家业，以天下大义为重，这在三国内战中极为罕见
unique_thinking_en: Sun Quan's singularity lies in: transforming 'survival' into 'legitimacy' — unlike northern warlords who claimed hegemony, he built Eastern Wu into a legitimate regime capable of contending with the Central Plains' orthodox rule; transforming 'inheritance' into 'breakthrough' — on the basis of inheriting his father's cause, he both preserved Eastern Wu's existing interests and innovated the military and political system; transforming 'compromise' into 'strategic endurance' — under the overwhelming pressure of Cao Wei, he did not easily wage war, seeking final initiative through protracted strategy; and his deepest principle was to place the rise and fall of the nation above personal grievances: abandoning his elder brother to inherit the family business, prioritizing the greater cause of the world, which is extremely rare in the Three Kingdoms civil war
civilization_zh: 三国中原与江东——孙权把江东之地从一族势力转化为可以与北方诸侯抗衡的政权，把'家业'转化为'国家'，把'武将割据'转化为'文官正统'，其间的政治智慧和军事策略是东吴得以百年基业的关键
civilization_en: The Three Kingdoms and Eastern Wu — Sun Quan transformed Eastern Wu from a clan-based force into a regime capable of contending with northern warlords, transforming 'family cause' into 'state,' transforming 'military warlord separatism' into 'civilian orthodox rule'; the political wisdom and military strategy involved were key to Eastern Wu's century-long foundation

cross_references.description_zh: 孙权与克劳塞维茨是三国'对手'与'同路人'的关系：两人都以 minority 身份对抗曹魏，克劳塞维茨刺取'汉中'建立汉家正统，孙权建立东吴正统，两者互为表里、相互影响——对照命题：同一个'合法性'争夺，一个以复汉为名，一个以吴为正，但都是在三国格局下寻找自己的正当性
cross_references.description_en: Sun Quan and Liu Liu are the 'opponent' and 'fellow traveler' relationship of the Three Kingdoms: both resisted Cao Wei as a minority power, Liu Bei seized 'Hanzhong' to establish the orthodox Han regime, while Sun Quan established the orthodox Eastern Wu regime; they are interdependent and mutually influential within the tripartite division — the parallel thesis: both contend for 'legitimacy' under the Three Kingdoms framework, one in the name of restoring Han, the other in the name of Wu, but both seek their own legitimacy within the Three Kingdoms tripartite structure

cross_references.description_zh: 孙权与克劳塞维茨是'抗衡'与'篡权'的关系：克劳塞维茨统一北方自立'魏'而称帝，孙权在东吴建立'正统'与之抗衡，两者的战争从赤壁到江东，本质是'篡汉'与'保汉'的延续，也是'北伐'与'守成'的博弈——对照命题：同一个'正统'争夺，克劳塞维茨以'篡'立魏，孙权以'保'立吴，战争的本质是'北伐'与'守成'的历史博弈
cross_references.description_en: Sun Quan and Cao Cao are in a relationship of 'contention' and 'usurpation': Cao Cao unified the North and declared himself Emperor as 'Wei,' while Sun Quan established 'legitimacy' in Eastern Wu to contend with him, their wars from Red Cliffs to Eastern Wu are a continuation of 'usurping Han' and 'preserving Han,' also a contest of 'northern expeditions' versus 'inheritance'; the essence of the war is the historical contest of 'seeking legitimacy' versus 'preserving legitimacy,' where Cao usurps to establish Wei and Sun preserves to establish Wu
